Oa--0 to 2 cm (0 to 1 in); highly decomposed plant material, very dark brown (7.5YR 2.5/2) rubbed moist; moderately acidic, pH 6.0; clear wavy boundary (0 to 7 cm, 0 to 3 in)
A--2 to 9 cm (1 to 4 in); highly organic fine sandy loam, black (7.5YR 2.5/1) rubbed moist; moderate medium subangular blocky structure; neutral, pH 7.2; very abrupt wavy boundary (5 to 35 cm, 2 to 15 in)
Bw/A--9 to 53 cm (4 to 13 in); fine sand, 50 percent brown (10YR 4/3) rubbed and 50 percent black (10YR 2/1) rubbed moist; moderate coarse subangular blocky structure; neutral, pH 7.2; very abrupt wavy boundary (35 to 67 cm, 15 to 26 in)

C2--106 to 130 cm (42 to 51 in); fine sand, black (7.5YR 2.5/1) rubbed moist; weak fine subangular blocky structure; moderately alkaline, pH 8.0.

GEOGRAPHICALLY ASSOCIATED SOILS.content:
GEOGRAPHICALLY ASSOCIATED SOILS: These are the Anajuk, Inigok, and Pingok series.
Anajuk soils are very poorly drained, have permafrost, have cryoturbated and glacic horizons, and occur on low relief troughs of high-center polygons.
Inigok soils are poorly drained, have permafrost, have cryoturbation, and occur on incised streams and patterned ground.
Pingok soils are very poorly drained, are organic soils, have permafrost and a glacic layer, and occur on high centered polygons.
